name: planvortex
description: Schedule posts, read comments and answer messages across eleven social networks.
long_description: The official MCP server for PlanVortex. Schedule and publish posts, read the comment and review inbox, answer private messages and pull stats across Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok, X, WhatsApp, YouTube, Google Business, Bluesky, Discord and Telegram. Needs a PlanVortex app from the Custom plan. This server never deletes anything.

client_id.title: Client ID
client_id.description: From your PlanVortex app (Custom plan): Settings > Apps.

organization_id.title: Default organization (optional)
organization_id.description: Leave empty if your app reaches a single organization.
